views.front: The smart toilet retains a recessed oval bowl, integrated pedestal and upper control housing.
views.rear: The back housing and bowl remain attached with a continuous smooth porcelain finish.
views.detail: The rim and bowl depth read clearly, while the small side control remains distinct.
